name: Target Feature Density Calculation
definition: A target feature density $\rho^*(x)$ used to steer the current feature density $\rho(x)$ during training, increasing density where error is high and decreasing it where error is low.
summary: Target Feature Density Calculation dynamically steers adaptive grid training by allocating resources based on reconstruction error, using logarithmic scaling to prioritize high-error regions more than static methods.
